newsitem.title: USA: Berkley Petroleum sees 1997 cashflow AT C$4.24. [CORRECTED 9:15 GMT 1/3]
newsitem.headline: Berkley Petroleum sees 1997 cashflow AT C$4.24. [CORRECTED 9:15 GMT 1/3]

text.p: Oil company Berkley Petroleum Corp expects its cash flow per share for 1997 will reach C$4.24, Mike Rose, the company's chief executive officer, told a conference on Friday.
He described this as "a minimum case scenario" and said that on this basis, cashflow would be C$70 million in 1997, up from a forecast C$25.9 million in 1996.
Production by the end of 1997 will be 20,000 barrels of oil equivalent per day, double the projected end 1996 level. ((-- New York Newsroom 212 859 1902))
